en: Diya al-Din Abu Muhammad Abdullah ibn Ahmad ibn al-Baytar
tr: Ziyâeddin Ebû Muhammed Abdullah b. Ahmed İbnü'l-Beytâr
ar: ضياء الدين أبو محمد عبد الله بن أحمد ابن البيطار

description.tr: Ortaçağ dünyasının en büyük botanikçi ve farmakoloğu — 1.400 tıbbi bitkiyi katalogladı (bilime 300 tamamen yeni), ilk sistematik parazitolog || İbnü'l-Beytâr, Mâleka'dan Kuzey Afrika üzerinden Mısır ve Levant'a seyahat ederek bitki örnekleri topladı. || [Tarih notu] Leclerc'in 1877-83 Fransızca çevirisi İbnü'l-Beytâr'ı ortaçağın en büyük farmakoloğu olarak belirledi.
description.en: Greatest botanist and pharmacologist of the medieval world — catalogued 1,400 medicinal plants (300 entirely new to science), the first systematic parasitologist || Ibn al-Baytar traveled from Málaga through North Africa to Egypt and the Levant, collecting plant specimens and documenting their medicinal properties. His Jami catalogued 1,400 plants with their uses in Arabic, Berber, Greek, Latin, Persian and Romance languages — 300 were entirely new to pharmacological literature. || [Historiographical note] Leclerc's 1877-83 French translation established Ibn al-Baytar as the greatest medieval pharmacologist. Meyerhof (1933) documented the 300 original plant descriptions.
description.ar: أعظم عالم نبات وصيدلة في العالم الوسيط — فهرس ١,٤٠٠ نبتة طبية || سافر ابن البيطار من مالقة عبر شمال أفريقيا إلى مصر والشام جامعًا العينات النباتية. فهرس ١,٤٠٠ نبتة بستّ لغات — ٣٠٠ منها جديدة كليًا على الأدب الصيدلاني
